data.name: Humaiba
data.gender_notes: Humaiba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Humaiba is derived from the Arabic word ‘Humaa’, which means patience and obedience. In Islamic history, Humaiba was the name of a noblewoman who was known for her patience and endurance during times of hardship. She is remembered as a model of strength and resilience in the face of adversity. The name Humaiba carries the meaning “Patient, Obedient” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humaiba usually hope their child will grow to embody patient, obedient and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Humaiba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Patient, Obedient.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humaiba total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
